description:
Mental Stillness | Santoor for Calm Mind | 1.5 Hours

If your mind has been racing since Monday and you can't seem to slow it down — start here. 1.5 hours of slow santoor designed for mental stillness and a quiet calm mind.

The santoor is a hammered Indian string instrument with crystalline clear notes — each strike like a small bell, structured enough to pull your attention into quiet.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Santoor — hammered Indian string instrument with clear bell-like tone
- Long resonant notes with natural breathing pauses
- A gentle Theta wave layer for deep mental calm
- Unbroken 1.5 hours — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — first quiet breath
12:00  Mind softening into stillness
35:00  Deep calm zone
65:00  Sustained mental quiet
80:00  Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play when your thoughts won't stop. Don't try to silence them — let the santoor do it. Headphones recommended for the Theta layer.

⏱ Best for:
• Mid-week mental overload
• Pre-sleep wind-down
• Reading and journaling
• Post-meeting reset
• Mind-racing nights

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura, Santoor and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus
